facts.fact: 专栏目击 Heath 本地兽医 Doc Forbes 街头训练，满身是汗。
facts.anchor: Spotted on the mean streets of Heath: Heath’s very own veterinarian, Doc Forbes, looking sweaty and utterly delicious, training for the Texas 10K.

facts.fact: 他将于三月在 Austin 跑 10K 并募捐。
facts.anchor: Doc Forbes will be running the 10K in Austin in March, and he’s collecting your donations!

facts.fact: 专栏号召去兽医诊所找前台 Sandra 捐款，善款归 Tri-town Pups。
facts.anchor: Pop in to the veterinary clinic and see Sandra on the front desk. Every cent you can spare will benefit the Tri-town Pups dog rescue.

facts.fact: 专栏呼吁到现场加油，并当面称 Harriet 幸运。
facts.anchor: We’ll all be there cheering on Doc Forbes! Harriet, you’re a lucky, lucky woman.

facts.fact: 征集八卦，邀请私信爆料。
facts.anchor: If you’ve got some hot Tri-towns gossip, slide on into my DMs…
